end.summary:
Zoya sequenced the Company’s rise from Charter to Plassey, Buxar and Crown rule.
They explained that revenue rights provided money for trade and army expenses.
They identified Plassey, Mir Jafar’s support and the leaders connected with Buxar.
The methods by which the Company gained power were not fully explained in the teach-back.
end.parentNote: Zoya practised the Company’s transition from trader to ruler, including Plassey, Buxar, Diwani and revenue use. They clearly linked land revenue to funding trade and the army, and corrected the idea that revenue meant only general tax collection by explaining Diwani as the right to collect revenue. They mixed up or left some details of the Buxar participants and became tired when the same points were revisited. At home, ask Zoya to make a four-step timeline and add one method of gaining power beside each event.
